notes.title: Optimized the design of the game
notes.content:
Several core experiences of the game have been adjusted



1. The parcels between the teams can finally be exchanged. The equipment purchased by Okur can be used by John!



2. During the battle and when the team passes the local city, if the soldiers are attacked and have no blood, they will never die completely again. Take the soldiers back to the hospital in the city as soon as possible. After they are treated again, they can return to the battlefield again!



3. If the soldier can upgrade, his upgrade button will be prompted obviously!

notes.title: The game is about to join the achievement system!
notes.content:
The game has entered a stable running period, and all kinds of bugs have been adjusted.

Many players are drying all kinds of advanced equipment in the group. How many have you got?

In order to add more game content, the game will be added to the series achievements!

You are also welcome to tell us what kind of achievements you expect to achieve.

notes.content:
